note: Synthetic + one real (masked) row for EP06 Meta ads circuit breaker. account_ref and adset_ref are masked before this file is ever written -- these are the SAME shapes the Mask + normalize node produces, so the demo lane and the live lane exercise identical downstream code. No page id anywhere. leads = MAX over action types matching /lead/i, never SUM.

rows.description: The real EP06 row, masked. Our own HVAC AU ad set, window 2026-08-30 to 2026-09-22 (24 days, explicit time_range because the campaign is paused and date_preset=today returns zero rows). This is the row that trips R2 (zero-lead spend cap).
Min-data guard: spend below min_spend_before_cpl_usd (25.00) -- every value-dependent rule must return unknown, never a breach.
R1 spend-cap breach: spend >= daily_spend_cap_usd (60.00) with leads present, above min-data floor.
R2 zero-lead breach: spend >= zero_lead_spend_usd (60.00) AND leads == 0. Mirrors the real row's shape but a clean synthetic to prove the branch independently of live data.
R3 CPL breach: leads >= 1 AND cpl (spend/leads) > cpl_cap_usd (25.00). spend 100 / leads 2 = cpl 50.00.
Clean pass: above min-data floor, under every cap, cpl under ceiling. No rule fires.

Lag guard: 0 leads but the window is still inside the conversion-lag settle time (some Meta action types settle up to 28h) -- must resolve unknown, not a breach, even though spend clears the zero-lead cap.

Two lead-ish action types on one row: 'lead' 3 and 'onsite_conversion.lead_grouped' 3. Correct leads = MAX(3,3) = 3. A SUM bug would read 6 and halve the true CPL -- this row is the regression fixture for that class of bug.
